top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The hand washing sink in the infant classroom was observed being used to clean pacifiers as well as prepare bottles.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application (26 TAC §745.621(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection, the full background check has not been completed.

top_violation_types.title: Field Trips - Notification to Parents (26 TAC §746.3003)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A notice was not posted informing parents of the departure and return times for the field trip children attended today.
